BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the Washington soldiers' home; adding newsections to chapter 72.36 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that continued supportof and medical assistance to our military veterans is of great priorityin the state of Washington. The legislature further finds that theWashington soldiers' home provides essential shelter, personal andnursing care, and related services to eligible military veterans.

(1) The department may receive gifts,grants, or endowments from public or private sources that are made fromtime to time, in trust or otherwise, for the use and benefit of thepurposes of the Washington soldiers' home. (2) The director of the department or the director's designeeshall: (a) Deposit moneys received under subsection (1) of this sectioninto the Washington soldiers' home account created in section 3 of thisact; p. 1 SB 6528 (b) Disburse the donated funds to the Washington soldiers' home forthe following purposes: Renovation and maintenance of its physicalfacilities.

The Washington soldiers' home account iscreated in the custody of the state treasurer. All receipts frompublic and private contributions to the Washington soldiers' home mustbe deposited into the account. Expenditures from the account may beused only for the purposes of section 2 of this act. Only the directorof the department or the director's designee may authorize expendituresfrom the account. The account is subject to allotment procedures underchapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is not required forexpenditures.
Sections 2 and 3 of this act are each addedto chapter 72.36 RCW.
